mentions.name: DeskTalk
mentions.description: An AI-native desktop environment that runs in the browser. Users describe the app they want (e.g. "build me a tracker"), AI builds it on the spot, and it can be tweaked in real time with live edits. The AI assistant also operates the environment itself — creating apps, editing them in place, and managing windows — to help users get work done instead of installing fixed software up front.
mentions.problem: Traditional software is fixed and requires installing many apps up front, rather than being created and modified on demand through natural language.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on DeskTalk(https://www.desktalk.ai/), an AI-native desktop environment that runs in the browser.
